objective: Implement deterministic fail-closed pre-trade revalidation that prevents final size, leverage, margin-utilization or portfolio-exposure metrics from becoming riskier than the canonical P15-B/P15-D/P15-E approvals.
scope: Require canonical eligible P15-B, P15-D and P15-E decisions
Compare final quantity against P15-B candidate_quantity
Compare final gross/net/correlated-cluster exposure against P15-D approved post-candidate metrics
Compare final leverage and margin utilization against P15-E approved post-candidate metrics
Allow equal or lower-risk final metrics
Emit deterministic PRETRADE_C_ELIGIBLE or VETO decisions
tests: Final quantity above approved candidate vetoes
Final gross exposure above approved metric vetoes
Final absolute net exposure above approved metric vetoes
Final correlated-cluster exposure above approved metric vetoes
Final leverage above approved metric vetoes
Final margin utilization above approved metric vetoes
Equal or lower-risk metrics remain eligible
No G8 or execution authority is emitted
P16-C evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P16-C module/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P16-B remains canonical complete and P16-D remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: No execution authority or production defaults
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
